title: Sneaker or shoe launch

fields.label: Page name
fields.help: Brand and shoe, e.g. Northline Tempo.

fields.label: The shoe
fields.help: Its name, what it's for, weight, price, and what it's made of: laces, tongue, upper, plate, foam, outsole.

fields.label: Colorways
fields.help: Four colorways with their names and colours.

fields.label: Release
fields.help: The release day and time, and how people get a pair (draw, raffle, first come).

fields.label: Fit advice
fields.help: Optional: runs small, true to size, wide fit...

fields.label: How should the page sound?
fields.help: A few words about the brand.

writerNotes: The shoe is a fixed drawing of a running trainer that comes apart into six layers as you scroll, always in this order: laces, tongue, upper, plate, foam (midsole), outsole. layers are their callout title, a short name for phones and one spec line, in the brand's words; specs (grams, millimetres) are facts from the brief, otherwise describe without numbers. If the shoe has no plate, describe the layer as a shank or stability layer rather than inventing a carbon plate.
product.bigA and product.bigB are the giant outline word behind the shoe (e.g. DRIFT / 1): the product name in capitals split in two, the second part short (a number or a short word).

colorways: exactly four, each with a short name (it is shown huge behind the shoe, so 4-9 letters work best) and seven shoe colours as #rrggbb: upper, over (overlays), mid (midsole), sole (outsole), lace, acc (small accent details), tongue; plus bg, a pale background for that colorway's section. The first colorway is the one the hero shows.
foam.heelMm is the heel stack height in millimetres (the press demo uses it); foam.body describes the foam.
drop: day (sun-sat) and time (HH:MM, 24-hour) of the release; the page counts down to the next one. drop.body says how people get a pair, from the brief.
size: the size finder converts foot length to US, UK and EU sizes with a fixed table; size.fine is the brand's fit advice.
brand.name is the logo and the giant footer word (capitals work best); footer.fine is a one-line copyright or note. theme.accent is the brand's one accent colour for buttons (white text on it).
business.name is set to exactly the name in the brief and cannot be changed.
